definitions.explanation: Easy to use or helpful in making things easier. Describes things, places, or services that save time or effort.

⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{便利|べんり}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's convenient because it's near the station.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{便利|べんり}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: There's a supermarket nearby, so it's very convenient. Daily shopping has become easier.

notes:
{便利|べんり} is a na-adjective meaning convenient, useful, or handy—describing things that save time and effort.

FORMS:
- Predicate: {便利|べんり}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (is convenient)
- Modifying nouns: {便利|べんり}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{便利|べんり}: convenient for ~
- {便利|べんり}な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: convenient location
- {便利|べんり}な⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: handy tool
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{便|べん}→便：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: good transportation access

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {便利|べんり}: convenient
- ⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧: inconvenient

WHAT CAN BE {便利|べんり}:
Things, places, services, and arrangements — a tool, an app, a location near a station, an opening time. It is not used to praise a person's character; ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ means someone others find handy to use, which is unflattering. To say a person is helpful, use ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧ or say they ⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧.

NEARBY WORDS:
- ⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧: serves a purpose, does its job. {便利|べんり} adds that it saves time or trouble.
- ⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧: easy to operate. A tool can be {便利|べんり} (it solves a problem) yet not ⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧ (it is awkward to handle).
- ⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧: physically comfortable. {便利|べんり} is about effort saved, ⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧ about how it feels.
